ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a schematic diagram of a food chain/food web, with box labels including Plants, insects, rabbits, sheep, eagles, foxes, mallee fowls, cats and echidnas. There is only one plant-type organism label, Plants, and Plants is located in the middle of the figure, with arrows pointing from Plants to some animals, such as rabbits, sheep, insects and mallee fowls. Reasoning: The question asks about the primary producer in this food chain. In biology, a primary producer is an organism that can make its own food and provide an energy source for consumers, usually plants. Therefore the primary producer in the figure is Plants.
